item.title: Report: US notified Israel that it will strike Iran tonight

The United States has notified Israel that it intends to strike Iran tonight, Kan News reported.
The report also stated that Israel is preparing for the possibility that President Donald Trump will instruct the expansion of the offensive in the coming days.
